title: Vessels S-immediate: Luminari Web ready for S9
description:
S-immediate readies the local Luminari Web client for S9's play tests, per
`docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md` (S-immediate progress).

## In this repository

- `9f49b3f1f` packages the harbor's west Testing Dock (room 1000389, (-66, 92)).
  It lived only in the untracked development world file and was lost when that
  file was replaced, so the harbor provisioner's ferry fare check failed on a
  fresh dump. The provisioner now merges it back in like the east dock.
- `1726b48f2` and the record commit after it: the S-immediate record, including
  the client work, the live check, and the verification.
- `13679d5f6`, already on the branch, is the S-immediate and S9 plan.

## In the local client (not pushed, by plan)

`/home/aiwithapex/projects/luminariweb`, branch `feat/ship-panel` from `main`
`41ced8a`; review with `git log -p 41ced8a..feat/ship-panel` there.

- A Ship inspector tab for the 21 vessel MSDP variables, with S8 wire-format
  fixtures and display tests, and the protocol checklist row.
- Three terminal renderer fixes found in the live check: color sequences split
  between chunks, line breaks replayed at chunk boundaries by ansi-to-html's
  stream mode, and LuminariMUD's zero-padded 256-color codes.
- A lint ignore for a local `.kilo/` tool worktree that broke `npm run lint`.

## Verification

See the record's Verification paragraph: client lint, tests and build; the
live check in the namespace harness; all 21 vessel live gates; the local CI
matrix.

S9 continues on `feat/vessels-s9` after this merges.
